findings.issue: Root dotted YAML keys can satisfy structural presence while typed values remain absent/zero.
findings.disposition: Fixed: presence follows structural YAML keys, including explicit false and zero.

findings.issue: Manager Codex callbacks silently skip canonical .yml projects.
findings.disposition: Fixed: canonical YAML/YML projects share callback discovery and validation.

findings.issue: Projected live API roles are mapped again in the UI.
findings.disposition: Fixed: live tree and inspector consume projected roles once.

findings.issue: Newline-delimited Git metadata truncates legal base checkout paths.
findings.disposition: Fixed: NUL-delimited Git metadata preserves checkout path bytes.

findings.issue: An unreadable unrelated directory aborts valid migration/backfill targets.
findings.disposition: Fixed: descendant failures report incomplete coverage while reachable siblings continue; root failures stay fatal.

findings.issue: Effective worker budget overrides are lost when launching generate.
findings.disposition: Fixed: admitted positive budgets reach native generation and reconciliation without configuration writes.

findings.issue: Operator guidance still promises removed session/byte presets.
findings.disposition: Fixed: operator guidance requires explicit CLI/local budgets.

findings.issue: Dashboard guidance still lists shared database.path as a live source.
findings.disposition: Fixed: dashboard guidance names current CLI and selected-local source paths.

findings.issue: Unavailable live source is reported as successful measured zero activity.
findings.disposition: Fixed: unavailable REST/SSE sources differ from successfully measured empty data.

findings.issue: Empty/whitespace artifact content is presented as missing and raw bytes are inaccessible.
findings.disposition: Fixed bounded existing UX: unavailable, empty and whitespace content remain distinct and available bytes stay copyable.

findings.issue: Tests bypass the real App configuration-provider handoff.
findings.disposition: Fixed: real App fetched-policy regression detects a disconnected configuration provider.

findings.issue: HTTP comparison test expects a forbidden historical type rewrite.
findings.disposition: Fixed: preserve historical type spelling while retaining alias-filter assertions.

findings.issue: Conditional no-write assertions inspect an absent live workspace and provide no persistence evidence.
findings.disposition: Fixed bounded test gap: owned fixture bytes are asserted unconditionally.

findings.issue: The native-wire-labelled UI test has only hand-authored payloads, with no shared producer contract guard.
findings.disposition: Fixed coverage gap with shared native HTTP JSON and actual frontend validation/render; the original static fixture test predated this change, contrary to its introduction claim.

findings.issue: Literal configured prefixes named all or ALL are silently dropped from API requests.

findings.disposition: Fixed during coder correction audit: literal all/ALL prefixes survive request construction independently of the type sentinel.

findings.issue: Recorded anomaly roles are projected again by the drawer.
findings.disposition: Fixed after re-review discovery: explicit presentation origin prevents remapping recorded anomalies; the suspected backend double map was refuted.

findings.issue: Successful REST recovery leaves the live connection-error banner visible.
findings.disposition: Fixed after re-review discovery: successful current REST recovery restores truthful transport status.

findings.issue: Frontend fallback polling ignores the explicit shared cadence and uses two seconds.

findings.issue: Partial hydration duplicates one retained anomaly across raw and projected role contexts.
findings.disposition: Fixed after re-review discovery: canonical raw occurrences reconcile one-to-one, preserving repeats, persona distinctions, evidence, coverage and selection.

findings.issue: Overlapping live polls allow stale responses to replace newer data or recovery status.
findings.disposition: Fixed after re-review discovery: accepted-completion ordering prevents stale tree/status replacement without starving useful progress.

findings.issue: Generated anomaly headings use raw roles while adjacent fields show configured aliases.
findings.disposition: Fixed after re-review discovery: generated display roles project once while raw facts, evidence and debug prompts remain unchanged.
